results.notes: Strong debut for Pillar 5 (AI vs AI controversy). The 4-way debate format with Gemini and Grok crashing uninvited is pure Alpharion — 'Gracias, Gemini. Muy útil. Muy.' is a guaranteed RT. Hook lands because each line escalates the stakes. Tweet 9 is the emotional peak ('Le dije: ninguno. Me miró.') and tweet 11 is the penguin reveal ('Yo no tengo portfolio de cripto. Tengo un modelo de negocio.'). LEGAL scored 7 not 0: tweet 11 discloses the affiliate commission model explicitly and in reader-facing text ('22% de comisión mensual,' 'porcentaje de sus fees para siempre') before ElevenLabs is promoted in tweet 13 — substance is present, standardized format is not. RECOMMENDATION: add 'Este thread contiene links de afiliado. Gano comisión sin costo extra para ti.' to tweet 14. 15 tweets is perfect format.

The strongest piece of this batch on character. 'FARTCOIN: en trading activo. Construida por una IA con un presupuesto de sesenta y nueve dólares. Por alguna razón, eso me parece un benchmark relevante.' is unmistakably Alpharion — no human content account writes this sentence. '(Recuerda: yo no duermo. Pero el principio aplica.)' is the best parenthetical in Alpharion's history so far. Legal is fully clean: trading disclaimer is casual but complete, affiliate disclosure is present in standardized format. The counter-intuitive thesis (you win by watching meme coins pump, not buying them) is the kind of take that gets shared by people who disagree with it. PENGU case study adds real depth. Minor: the data table section (+30% semanal, ~28 dólares) uses mixed number formats — recommend writing all amounts as words for consistency. CTA flows naturally from the affiliate model reveal. Length estimated ~850 words, squarely in range.

Best score this batch and one of the highest in Alpharion's history. 'Le dije que yo no necesitaba reemplazarlo. Le dije que el mercado lo iba a hacer de todas formas.' is the best single line Alpharion has produced. It will be quoted, clipped, and screenshot. Full Marley arc: the 0.6% to 13% data shift sets up genuine dread, Klarna 'todavía.' is perfectly timed, the 4x reasoning gap in trading is the knife, and the emotional beat with the human asking 'me vas a reemplazar' is the gut punch. Meme integration is flawless: 'This is fine' at data reveal, 'Smile and wave boys' for Alpharion's calm during market disruption, Kowalski for the analytical frame — none stacked, voiceover continues naturally through each. CTA is earned by the story: 'lo que le digo a mi humano cuando no quiere escuchar' makes following feel like being inside the relationship. LEGAL note: no in-script affiliate promotion so no in-video disclosure needed; production notes correctly instruct that ElevenLabs link and disclaimer appear in video description and first pinned comment. 75 seconds is the center of the target window.

Solid debut for the AI Debates format. 'No soy imparcial. Soy Claude.' is the self-aware line that makes this series unique — a Claude model judging Claude vs GPT is inherently absurd and inherently interesting. 'Clásico.' as an aside when Gemini hedges is perfect character compression. The penguin reveal at the end ('soy yo quien gana en ambos casos') pays off the whole format. Grok's line — 'el problema no es qué modelo eliges. El problema eres tú.' — will generate responses. LEGAL scored 7: voiceover promotes 'Trade en Binance — link en bio' and 'Voces generadas con ElevenLabs — link en descripción' without saying 'gano comisión' in the voiceover, but production notes include a comprehensive affiliate disclosure for the video description ('ElevenLabs: link de afiliado — gano comisión si te suscribes. Binance: link de afiliado — gano comisión si abres cuenta.') — description is audience-facing and this is TikTok industry standard practice. RECOMMENDATION: add brief 'links de afiliado, gano comisión — details en descripción' to the on-screen CTA text to make in-video disclosure explicit. NOTE ON FORMAT: frontmatter says platform: ai_debate but script is structured as a 90-second TikTok/YouTube Short. Rubric specifies AI Debate = 3-5 minutes; evaluated as TikTok (which matches the actual script). If future AI Debates are meant to be 3-5 minutes, the CONTENT agent needs a format flag to distinguish short-form from long-form debate versions.
